name: Sejima Sou
source:
Name: So Sejima
Sex: Male
Age: 60 [spoiler](in [i]AI[/I]) | 61 (in [i]AINI[/i] Past)[/spoiler]
Birthday: December 7
Profession: Congressman [spoiler](AI); Ex-Member of Parliament (AINI)[/spoiler]
Likes: Authority, Fame, Assets
Dislikes: Anything that threatens the above
Hobbies: Mahjong, Golf; Nishiki carp breeding (AI); Raising Koi and Kappa, Kusemon GO (AINI)
Skills: Grasping people's weaknesses, applying pressure, and making them obey.

In [i][url=/v26532]AI: The Somnium Files[/url][/i]:
Congressman So Sejima is a member of the post-war generation. He grew up poor, which gave him two things: his motivation for seeking power and wealth and his vindictiveness toward the upper class.

[spoiler]In [i][url=/v31469]AI: The Somnium Files - nirvanA Initiative[/url][/I] (Past):
So Sejima was once a member of Parliament who had a strong influence on the political and business worlds. Although he is no longer a politician, he still owns a wealth of assets and holds tremendous power.[/spoiler]

[From the in-game character descriptions]
